```{r setup}
library(SimPlot)
library(dplyr)
```

## 
```{r}
sim_data1 = data.frame(x = runif(n = 20, min = 0, max = 1)) |> 
  mutate(y = 1 + 1.5*x + rnorm(n = 20, mean = 0, sd = 1))

m = lm(y ~ x, data = sim_data1)
```

```{r}
sim_plot(m)
```

```{r}
sim_plot(m, xvar = "x")
```

```{r}
sim_data2 = data.frame(x = runif(n = 20, min = 0, max = 1)) |>
  mutate(y = rbinom(n = 20, size = 1, prob = plogis(0.1 + 0.8*x))) |>
  mutate(y = ifelse(y == 0, "cat a", "cat b") |> as.factor())

m2 = glm(y ~ x, data = sim_data2, family = binomial())
```

```{r}
sim_plot(m2)
```

```{r}
sim_plot(m2, xvar = "body_mass")
```
